_comment: Spellings merged by the 2026-09-25 review, per field: the key is the retired value, the value is the one to use. 'retired' lists values a field must not carry at all, with the reason. checks.mjs V19 enforces both.

subcategories.public-domain: a licence, not a kind of content; the license field records it
